Name: Pumpkin House for Alternative Textures
Author: TheFrenchDodo
Description:
This mod turns your house into a giant pumpkin!

To use, simply click your house with the Paint Bucket tool from Alternative Textures.

The texture can be applied on any upgrade of the farmhouse. It has no seasonal variant, because every season should be pumpkin season!

Other mods shown in screenshots:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14027]Sakura Interface Redux[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13756]Horse to Ostrich[/url]
